kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اعترضوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضُوا (iʕtaraḍū) /iʕ.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضُوا (uʕturiḍū) /uʕ.tu.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اِعْتَرِضُوا (iʕtariḍū) /iʕ.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
